Homemade Spiced Schnapps

Served at: Krampusnacht

About 1 quart (1 liter)Prep 10 minCook 7 days infusion

Schnapps is a traditional strong spirit often enjoyed during Krampusnacht, a festive night celebrated on December 5th in Alpine regions. This spiced schnapps recipe captures the warming flavors of the holiday, perfect for sharing as a toast to ward off the cold and mischievous Krampus.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups (480 ml) neutral grain alcohol or vodka (at least 40% ABV)
  • 1 cinnamon stick
  • 5 whole cloves
  • 3 star anise pods
  • 1 teaspoon dried orange peel
  • 1/2 teaspoon crushed cardamom pods
  • 1/4 cup (50 g) granulated sugar
  • 1/4 cup (60 ml) water

Method

  1. Combine the cinnamon stick, cloves, star anise, dried orange peel, and crushed cardamom pods in a clean glass jar with a tight-fitting lid.
  2. Pour the grain alcohol or vodka over the spices, seal the jar, and shake gently to mix.
  3. Store the jar in a cool, dark place for 7 days, shaking it gently once a day to infuse the flavors.
  4. After 7 days, prepare a simple syrup by heating the sugar and water in a small saucepan over medium heat until the sugar dissolves completely; let it cool.
  5. Strain the infused alcohol through a fine mesh sieve or cheesecloth into a clean container to remove the spices.
  6. Stir the cooled simple syrup into the strained alcohol to sweeten the schnapps.
  7. Transfer the schnapps to a clean bottle and seal tightly.
  8. Chill before serving and enjoy in small glasses as part of your Krampusnacht celebration.

Tips

  • Adjust the sweetness by adding more or less simple syrup according to your taste.
  • For a fruitier schnapps, add dried cherries or apple slices to the infusion.
  • Always drink schnapps responsibly and in moderation, especially during festive gatherings.
